description_en: Collects real-time call statistics for agents
description_zh: 实时统计座席通话数据
name: CloudAgentMonitorStatistics

parameters.help_en:
The call center ID.

Before calling this operation, create a call center instance in the Cloud Contact Center console and obtain the instance ID from the instance access URL
parameters.help_zh:
呼叫中心 id

调用前需在云联络中心控制台创建呼叫中心实例，并从实例访问地址中获取实例 ID
parameters.name: enterprise_id

parameters.help_en: The names of the statistics fields. Specify the field names used in queue real-time statistics. Separate multiple field names with commas (,). By default, all statistics fields are queried
parameters.help_zh: 统计项名称；取队列实时统计的统计字段名称，多个队列统计项之间使用英文逗号","分隔，默认查询所有统计项
parameters.name: fields

parameters.help_en: The agent IDs used to query statistics for specified agents. You can specify multiple agent IDs separated by commas (,). By default, statistics information for all agents under the account is queried
parameters.help_zh: 说明：根据座席工号查询指定座席的统计项名称支持按照多个座席工号进行查询，多个座席工号之间使用英文逗号","分隔，默认查询账户下所有座席的统计信息
parameters.name: cnos

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable outbound group query. Valid values: 0: disabled (default). 1: enabled
parameters.help_zh: 是否需要外呼组查询；说明：0 关闭外呼组查询，1 开启外呼组查询。默认为关闭状态
parameters.name: is_use_gno

parameters.help_en: The outbound group IDs used to query statistics for specified agents. You can specify multiple outbound group IDs separated by commas (,). By default, statistics information for all agents under the account is queried
parameters.help_zh: 说明：根据外呼组编号查询指定座席的统计项名称支持按照多个外呼组编号进行查询，多个座席工号之间使用英文逗号","分隔，默认查询账户下所有座席的统计信息
parameters.name: gno

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return. The value must be a positive integer. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 500
parameters.help_zh: 条数；正整数，默认值是10，最大值是500
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The starting position of the query. The value must be a positive integer. Default value: 0. This parameter is used together with Limit. For example, if offset is set to 50 and limit is set to 10, the sixth page is queried with 10 entries per page, which returns records 51 through 60
parameters.help_zh: 查询页码数的起始条数；正整数，默认值是0；与limit同步使用，例：offset=50,limit=10,表示查询第6页，每页10条数据，即总记录的第51-60条数据
parameters.name: offset

parameters.help_en: The start hour of the statistical period. The value must be a positive integer from 0 to 23. Maximum value: 23
parameters.help_zh: 统计时间段；正整数，0～23，最大值是23时
parameters.name: start_hour

parameters.help_en: The end hour of the statistical period. The value must be a positive integer from 1 to 24. Maximum value: 24
parameters.help_zh: 统计时间段；正整数，1～24，最大值是24时
parameters.name: end_hour

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return the queue name. Valid values: 0: not required (default). 1: required
parameters.help_zh: 是否需要返回队列名称；0：不需要（默认） 1：需要
parameters.name: is_need_queue_name

CurrentState.description_en: status: The agent state. Valid values: stateIdle: idle. statePause: busy. stateCalling: calling. stateInuse: in a call. stateWrapup: wrapping up. loginTime: The time when the agent logged on. startTime: The time when the call started
